description: Kalmunai Municipal Council - Proposed Budget Report - 2020
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the public inspection period for a municipal budget proposal and invites public comments. It deals with local government administrative procedures (budget review process) but does not involve central government structure/personnel (Types 1-3), nor does it fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). As a local government administrative notice about budget procedures, it falls under Miscellaneous.
